name: Sarah Dullin
source:
The only child in the Dullin household (which happens to be rich). She was the one who found Elmo when he was lying beside the lake. Also a childhood friend. Her relationship with Elmo is pretty tangled up since her mother tries to object Sarah to be in contact with Elmo. But Sarah likes being with Elmo. She’s more of a shy and silent character.
